ValidationRule.description: Blocks user to enter a past End Date

/* AND( OR($RecordType.DeveloperName = "Event", $RecordType.DeveloperName = "Main_Event_Campaign"), AND(DATEVALUE(Event_End_Date_Time__c) < TODAY(),OR(ISCHANGED(Event_End_Date_Time__c),ISNEW())), $Permission.Skip_Validations_Permission = False) */
